Author Graham Hancock joins Joe Rogan for episode 417 of the Joe Rogan Experience, an early visit in the show's run. Hancock was then building the case that made him the top voice for a lost Ice Age high culture. The talk helped carry that case to a vast crowd.

Hancock lays out the sites and signs he reads as proof of the lost world. He argues the experts guard a tale that the stones refute. Rogan lets the case run long and asks the fan questions. Listeners get the seed of a fame that grew for years. The library keeps the episode as a record of his stated case.
